subject: Upcoming Event: Annual Company Picnic
body: Dear team members, We are excited to announce that our annual company picnic is coming up on Saturday, July 24th at Central Park. Please RSVP by July 10th so we can finalize the headcount for catering and activities. This year, we have planned fun games, delicious food, and great prizes for everyone to enjoy. We look forward to seeing you all there for a day of relaxation and team bonding. Best regards, The HR Team
